title: Paginated query
name: loadPage
english: Load one page of data from the server and keep the previous page on screen while the next one loads.

inputs.name: load
inputs.type: (req: {pageIndex, pageSize, offset}) => Promise<{items: T[], total: number}>
inputs.sentence: What loads one page from the server.

inputs.name: pageSize
inputs.sentence: How many items a page holds.

inputs.name: pageIndex
inputs.sentence: The page to start on, counting from zero.

outputs.name: items
outputs.sentence: The items of the page on screen.

outputs.name: total
outputs.sentence: How many items the server has.

outputs.name: placeholder
outputs.sentence: Whether the items on screen are the previous page while the next one loads.

outputs.name: hasNextPage
outputs.sentence: Whether there is a next page.

events.sentence: The page asked for starts loading.
The person goes to the next page.
The person goes back a page.
The person changes how many items a page shows.

wraps.concept: useQuery with placeholderData keepPreviousData and isPlaceholderData; pagination state {pageIndex, pageSize}
wraps.adapter: The load input is the query function; pageRequest gives the query key parts and placeholder mirrors isPlaceholderData.

phrases: load the list page by page
fetch one page at a time

signals.sentence: This function loads data one page at a time by hand.
